name: Project Stakeholders
excerpt: Project Stakeholders are any persons involved in or affected by the project.
notes: Project Stakeholders include anyone involved in or affected by the project, such as the project sponsor, project manager, project team, support staff, suppliers, and opponents.
context_summary:
- Include persons involved in or affected by the project.
- Examples are project sponsor, project manager, project team, support staff, suppliers, and opponents.
